js: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ui .plate')].filter(e => !e.classList.contains('modal') && e.offsetParent !== null && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden').map(e => [e.id || e.className, e.getBoundingClientRect()]).filter(([, b]) => b.width > 0); const o = []; for (let a = 0; a < r.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < r.length; b++) { const A = r[a][1], B = r[b][1]; if (A.left < B.right - 1 && B.left < A.right - 1 && A.top < B.bottom - 1 && B.top < A.bottom - 1) o.push(r[a][0] + ' / ' + r[b][0]); } return o; })()
